capabilities: Render a parent/siblings/children navigation block at the top of notes in Reading view and Live Preview
Navigate to the parent folder or first child file via commands
Create notes, folder notes, and folders from the children index without overwriting existing paths
Tint and sort navigation pills by file type in natural order
Hide the block per note via frontmatter or collapse it per note
disambiguation: Navigates the folder tree around a note (parent, siblings, children), not headings or links inside the note.
extras: Default interface language is Simplified Chinese (English selectable in settings); also installable via BRAT; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
intentEvidence: Inspired by SiYuan's hierarchyNavigate and built on AidenLX's Folder Note semantics.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows the folder tree separately, so you cannot see where the current note sits in the hierarchy without leaving the note.

relations.evidence: Inspired by SiYuan's hierarchyNavigate and built on AidenLX's Folder Note semantics.
Works with Folder Note, so a Folder Note navigates as the folder it represents

summary: Folder-hierarchy navigator that renders a parent, siblings, and children block at the top of each note, injected at render time without modifying files.
